scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace shared && concurrently "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.db:init: docker exec repo-intel-postgres psql -U postgres -d repo_intel -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;" && npm run prisma:generate --workspace backend && npm run prisma:push --workspace backend
scripts.setup:dev: npm run db:up && npm run db:init && npm run build --workspace shared
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend
